data.description: Avena 2: Your Gateway to Inspired Living
data.long_description:
Avena blends modern living with the serenity of nature, offering a community that embraces sustainability and harmony with the environment.

Avena 2 introduces a collection of elegant 4-bedroom villas, each designed as a symbol of refined living. With three distinct façade styles, these homes emphasize modern elegance, showcasing sleek, clean lines that form a stunning and unified community aesthetic.

The community at Avena 2 is rich in outdoor amenities crafted for relaxation and recreation. Residents can unwind in beautifully landscaped areas, enjoy starlit movies at the outdoor theater, and connect with friends and family in inviting common areas. For active residents, a swimming pool and gym support a healthy lifestyle, while children have their own playground for endless fun.

Ideally located near Al Ain Road, Avena 2 provides easy access to Dubai’s main destinations. Rugby Sevens Stadium is just 5 minutes away, Dubai Outlet Mall in 8 minutes, and Downtown Dubai, including Burj Khalifa, is reachable within 25 minutes.
